complexity.notes: The dict keys come from a fixed 3-element literal, so collisions are bounded and lookups are O(1) even in the worst case. Checking membership with `bracket in "({["` is fine here given the tiny alphabet; a set literal would be marginally more idiomatic but no faster asymptotically.
complexity.summary: Classic stack-based validation: push opening brackets, and on each closing bracket check that it matches the most recent unmatched opener via a fixed closing-to-opening map. Returns true only if the stack is empty at the end.
